清晨，点点和豆豆醒来，天空阴沉沉的。
点点和豆豆对着天空祈祷：“不要下雨，不要下雨。”
要是下雨，今天的郊游就要泡汤了。
轰隆隆，轰隆隆！打雷了。“哗——”
顿时，大雨倾盆而下。
唉，天空真不够意思！
不能去郊游，点点和豆豆无聊极了。
找动画片来看——这是爸爸的建议。
画一幅画——这是妈妈的建议。
好吧，那就看会儿动画片吧。
page_text_en:
In the morning, Dian Dian and Dou Dou woke up, and the sky was gloomy.
Dian Dian and Dou Dou prayed to the sky: "Don't rain, don't rain."
If it rains, today's outing will be ruined.
Boom, boom! Thunder! "Splash——"
Suddenly, heavy rain poured down.
Ah, the sky is really unkind!
Can't go on the outing, Dian Dian and Dou Dou are bored.
Watch an animated show — that's Dad's suggestion.
Draw a picture — that's Mom's suggestion.
Alright, let's watch an animated show for a while.
summary_zh: 清晨，点点和豆豆希望天气晴朗以便郊游，但突然下起大雨，他们感到失望。父母建议他们看动画片或画画，最终他们决定先看动画片。

妈妈也挺无聊的，她居然找出了一块很久之前买的碎花布，想给自己做一条长裙子。
她想量一量要剪多长，可是，她怎么也找不到卷尺。
妈妈让爸爸想想办法。爸爸拿着报纸，怎么也想不出办法来。
真让人失望！
点点拿着遥控器跳起来，她有办法。
page_text_en:
Mom was also bored. She found a floral fabric she had bought a long time ago and wanted to make herself a long skirt.
She wanted to measure how long to cut it, but she couldn't find the measuring tape.
Mom asked Dad to think of a solution. Dad, holding a newspaper, couldn't think of anything.
This was really disappointing!
Dian Dian jumped up with the remote control in hand. She had an idea.
summary_zh: 妈妈想用碎花布做裙子但找不到卷尺，爸爸也想不出办法，点点突然跳起来表示她有办法。

title_zh: 了解长度：量一量，有多长
title_en: Measuring Length: How Long Is It?

page_text_ocr_zh:
点点让妈妈站直，然后拿着遥控器先在妈妈的腿上量了几下。
妈妈的腰到脚跟那儿，是七个遥控器那么长。
点点又拿着遥控器在碎花布上量了七个遥控器的长度，并做了标记。
现在，妈妈知道该在哪儿下剪刀了。

不过，还得量量腰围。
妈妈拿了一截毛线，说她自己会量。
毛线测量！真是太聪明了。
豆豆注意到，点点给妈妈和花布测量的时候，下一个起点总是上一个末尾。
首尾相接，这样量出来的长度才精确。
page_text_en:
Dian Dian asked Mom to stand straight, then used a remote control to measure Mom's legs a few times.
From Mom's waist to her heels, it was as long as seven remote controls.
Dian Dian then used the remote control to measure seven remote control lengths on the floral fabric and made a mark.
Now, Mom knew where to cut the fabric.

But they still needed to measure the waist.
Mom took a piece of yarn and said she could measure it herself.
Measuring with yarn! That's so clever.
Dou Dou noticed that when Dian Dian measured Mom and the fabric, the next starting point was always the end of the previous one.
Connecting end to start, this way the measured length is accurate.
summary_zh: 点点用遥控器为妈妈测量腿长并标记在布料上，妈妈随后用毛线测量腰围，豆豆观察到点点测量时采用首尾相接的方法，确保测量精确。

page_text_ocr_zh:
豆豆有多高？
量一量。豆豆有六支铅笔那么高。
点点有多高？
量一量。点点有六支半铅笔那么高。
豆豆拿了铅笔，在妈妈身上量了量。
妈妈的腰到脚跟那儿，只有五支铅笔那么长。
怎么和点点量的不一样？
这是因为铅笔比遥控器长！使用的工具不一样，得出的结果也不一样喽。
不只是遥控器可以用来测量长度，
文具盒、书、报纸、擀面杖也都可以用来测量长度。
page_text_en:
How tall is DouDou?
Let's measure. DouDou is as tall as six pencils.
How tall is DianDian?
Let's measure. DianDian is as tall as six and a half pencils.
DouDou took a pencil and measured his mom.
From her waist to her heels, it's only five pencils long.
Why is it different from what DianDian measured?
Because pencils are longer than the remote control! Using different tools gives different results.
Not only can a remote control be used to measure length,
but also pencil cases, books, newspapers, and rolling pins can be used to measure length.
summary_zh: 本页通过豆豆和点点用铅笔测量身高和妈妈身体部位的活动，展示了使用不同工具测量同一物体时结果会不同，并举例说明了多种可用来测量长度的日常物品。

一条蛇有多长？
“帮我量一量，我也想知道我有多长？”
啊，真的来了一条蛇。
量一量，这条蛇有十个文具盒那么长。
大象的鼻子有多长？
啊，真的来了只大象。
“帮我量一量，我也想知道我的鼻子有多长。”
量一量，大象的鼻子有十一本书那么长。
page_text_en:
How long is a snake?
"Help me measure, I also want to know how long I am."
Ah, here comes a snake.
Measure it, this snake is ten pencil cases long.
How long is an elephant's trunk?
Ah, here comes an elephant.
"Help me measure, I also want to know how long my trunk is."
Measure it, the elephant's trunk is eleven books long.
summary_zh: 本页通过测量蛇和大象鼻子的长度，展示了使用文具盒和书本作为非标准单位进行测量的方法，强调了测量时单位的统一性和结果的表达方式。

Oh, here comes a giraffe.

世界上最小的袋鼠有多长？

“帮我量一量，我也想知道我有多长？”
量一量，麝香袋鼠只有一个爸爸的手机那么长。
野猪的牙齿有多长？
啊，来了只胖胖的野猪太太。
“我不需要知道牙齿有多长，
我想请你们帮我量一量，我的腰围
有多长？”
豆豆拿来毛线球，在野猪太太

page_text_en:
How long is the world's smallest kangaroo?
Ah, here comes a musk kangaroo.
"Help me measure, I also want to know how long I am!"
Measure it, the musk kangaroo is as long as Dad's phone.
How long are the wild boar's teeth?
Ah, here comes a plump wild boar lady.
"I don't need to know how long my teeth are,
I want you to help me measure my waist circumference.
How long is it?"
DouDou brought a ball of yarn, wrapped it around the wild boar lady's waist once, and cut it off to give to her.
summary_zh: 本页展示了两只动物请求测量身体部位的长度：麝香袋鼠用爸爸的手机作为单位测量自身长度，野猪太太则请豆豆用毛线球测量她的腰围，豆豆将毛线绕腰一圈后剪下作为测量结果。

At this moment, Mom came out holding the new skirt.
"I love this skirt so much," Mrs. Wild Boar said as she put it on—perfectly fitted, as if made just for her.
Mom gave the skirt to Mrs. Wild Boar. She said, "This skirt seems too big on me."
"We look about the same size. You must have given it to me specially. You're so kind!" Mrs. Wild Boar laughed with joy.
Wow, Mom's waist is just as thick as Mrs. Wild Boar's!
